jobs.title: Data Product Manager - Core Data Product (f/m/d)
Project Manager, Science (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally

Your Role

This Project Manager will support the development, integration, and operations of our science efforts including experimental projects related to our Omega, Phelix, ELI, and simulation modeling efforts, helping translate technical objectives into executable plans and ensuring delivery across multidisciplinary teams.

You will act as a central point of coordination between our Science team, engineering partners, facilities, and the company PMO, bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex technical work.

This role is ideal for someone with project management experience who is comfortable in labs, hardware environments, or R&D settings, and who wants to deepen their technical and program execution skills over time.

What you’ll do:

  • Plan and track projects, translating technical goals into clear tasks, schedules, and milestones

  • Maintain project plans, schedules, and workflows in Jira, and Confluence

  • Track progress and follow up with engineers and technical leads on deliverables

  • Coordinate meetings, reviews, and planning sessions; document decisions and action items

  • Produce clear status updates, dashboards, and reports for division and PMO stakeholders

  • Support risk, issue, and change tracking across hardware, lab, and facility-related work

  • Coordinate across teams including Science & Technology, Facilities, and external partners

  • Coordinate with company-wide PM efforts to ensure compliance with company-wide standards

Who you are:

  • Master’s degree or higher in Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or a related technical field

  • Depth of experience in R&D related project management and coordination

  • Familiarity with Jira, and Confluence, or similar tools/technology

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams

  • Clear communicator who follows through and keeps teams aligned

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German

Nice to have’s:

  • Background in physics, optics, experimental science, or hardware development

  • Exposure to lab infrastructure

  • Familiarity with Agile or hybrid project management methods

  • Comfortable working in hardware, lab, or R&D environments

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Core Platform (Engine, Scale & Reliability)
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

 

Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.

 

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

 

OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

  • Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

  • Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

  • Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

  • Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

 

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

  • Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

  • Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

  • Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

  • Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

  • Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

  • Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

(Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform- Core (f/m/d)
Technical Product Manager (All gender)
jobs.description:
About Us

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

At the heart of our robotic platforms are robust sensor networks and reliable operating systems. As a Robotics Product Owner, you will be the vital link between high-level system requirements and daily engineering execution.


Your mission

You will guide a cross-functional team of hardware and software engineers through a rapidly growing portfolio of projects. By taking inputs from system engineers and program managers, you will ensure the team always has clear, actionable, and prioritized work, while keeping the broader organization informed of our technical capabilities.


Responsibilities

  • Translate Needs: Work closely with system engineers and program managers to break down complex system requirements into clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the engineering team.

  • Push the Backlog: Regularly align with the team lead to manage and prioritize the team's backlog across the hardware and software stack, balancing long-term foundational architecture with immediate project milestones.

  • Drive Execution: Facilitate daily alignment across the team—from hardware engineers working on optics and supplier specs, to software engineers building out embedded systems and sensor overlays—to unblock work and keep sprints moving smoothly.

  • Document Capabilities: Maintain clear, accessible, and up-to-date documentation of our technical capabilities, system resources, and sprint outcomes so stakeholders always know what the team can deliver.

  • Evaluate & Accept Work: Review completed engineering work against requirements, navigating collaborative trade-offs when friction arises between hardware constraints, embedded software performance, and project timelines.


Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager, or similar roles, specifically working on hardware-software integrated products, robotics, IoT, or complex technical platforms.

  • Technical Literacy: You are comfortable reviewing technical structures, navigating code repositories on GitLab, and collaborating effectively with software engineers.

  • Systems Thinking: A solid understanding of the robotics and embedded tech stack. You should feel comfortable discussing sensor calibration, edge computing (like Jetson platforms), driver integration, and overall system architecture.

  • Communication: Exceptional ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, acting as the bridge between deeply technical engineers and higher-level program managers.


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with sensor hardware lifecycles and optics.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, Jetson carrier boards, or base image configuration.

  • Experience with Agile frameworks in a hardware context.

  • Previous experience working in the defense, aerospace, or autonomous vehicle sectors.

We know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds. If you don't have these exact qualifications but feel you could succeed in this role, please apply anyway.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Dictation
jobs.description:
About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

The Role

Product development at Nabla is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads. Each squad owns a product area end to end, with a product manager, a group of engineers, and the subject matter experts the work requires.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of the Dictation squad: a product that clinicians touch many times a day, that is critical to their day to day efficiency, and strategically pairs with Nabla's ambient product to cover all user settings.

This role sits at the intersection of ML, user experience, and customer success. You will work day to day with ML, backend, and frontend engineers on a product where model performance is only half the story. The other half is the interface, the latency, the recovery path when something goes wrong, and the dozens of small frictions that decide whether a clinician keeps using the product or quietly walks away. You will also be the one who pulls the right insight out of user feedback and supports the rollout of the product inside large health systems. Expect to reason about model quality and evaluation with your ML engineers one hour, then join a design review, dig through user feedback, or sit down with a client the next.

Above all, this is a role for someone with genuine curiosity about how clinicians work. You will spend real time with users, including regular visits to client sites in the US, watching how they move through their day and where our product costs them seconds they cannot spare. The best ideas here come from observation.

Nabla is growing fast and our users expect more of us every day. If you like owning a product end to end, care about the details, and want your work judged by whether clinicians actually adopt it, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Nabla Dictation product, be accountable for its adoption and the quality-of-life improvements it delivers to clinicians.

  • Lead user-centric discovery: run interviews, dig into user feedback, shadow clinicians, and leverage usage data to find the frictions worth removing.

  • Work day to day with ML, backend, and frontend engineers to turn model capabilities into a product that becomes essential to clinician's day to day, making the trade-offs between quality, latency, cost, and time to market.

  • Partner with Design to make sophisticated technology feel simple, including the edge cases and failure paths that determine whether clinicians trust it.

  • Support deployment with our clients, including enterprise health systems: build strong relationships with Nabla champions and keep key stakeholders informed as the product evolves.

  • Define what good looks like: set the quality bar and the metrics that track it, from model performance through to adoption, retention, and support burden.

  • Prioritize ruthlessly between ambitious bets and the steady grind of removing friction, and be able to explain why.

Qualifications

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of product management experience in a technical or engineering-heavy environment.

  • Experience working closely with ML teams on products where model quality drives user value, and comfort discussing evaluation, quality metrics, and iteration loops with ML engineers.

  • Strong user empathy and a real appetite for diving deep into user workflows, with a track record of removing friction that others had accepted as normal.

  • Excellent product judgment and UX sensibility: you identify the high-value problems, define a strategy, and ship improvements users actually notice.

  • Proven ability to collaborate with frontend, backend, and ML engineers and to earn credibility with them.

  • Strong analytical skills: you define success metrics, read product data, and combine qualitative and quantitative evidence to decide.

  • Clear, structured communication, with the ability to explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving environment with incomplete information, competing priorities, and high ownership.

  • Location and language: based in our Paris office, with regular travel to client sites in the US. Full professional fluency in English is required; French is a plus.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare, or in another regulated or safety-critical industry.

  • Experience with speech, real-time, or other latency-sensitive products.

  • Prior software engineering experience, or the ability to write scripts and reason about system logs, API schemas, and data models.

  • Experience with B2B products used every day in demanding frontline workflows.

  • Experience building for the US market.

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Once a deal is won, you'll partner with the Enterprise Project Manager and CSMs to ensure a clean handover into rollout.

You'll be part of the Enterprise team, reporting to the Head of Enterprise, with monthly 1:1s and weekly check-ins.

About your new role

  • Lead technical discovery with prospects — digging into their current infrastructure, data, and workflows to understand where processes break down, not just what they say they want.

  • Design and build prospect-specific demo environments using their own terminology, structures, and use cases, showing exactly what daily life on ChurchDesk would look like.

  • Set up and run scoped proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments that validate security, performance, and functional fit ahead of contract signature.

  • Own the technical response to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires (encryption, GDPR, hosting, API limits) as the central technical point of contact, working closely with the AE.

  • Secure the "technical win" by getting IT, security, and data-protection stakeholders to formally confirm ChurchDesk meets their requirements

  • Document technical commitments, constraints, and dependencies, and hand over a clean, accurate technical picture to the Enterprise Project Manager and CSM — ensuring what was sold is what gets delivered.

  • Act as the prospect's Trusted Technical Advisor and the deal's technical conscience throughout the sales cycle, giving honest and accurate answers even when it means surfacing limitations early.


Skills & Requirements

  • Proven track record in a pre-sales, Solutions Engineering, or technical sales role, ideally with enterprise or complex B2B deals.

  • Strong technical discovery skills — able to dig into infrastructure, data, and workflows to uncover real problems, not just stated requirements.

  • Hands-on experience building tailored product demos and running proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments.

  • Working knowledge of security, data protection, and compliance topics (encryption, GDPR, hosting, API limits), with the ability to answer RFP/RFI questionnaires accurately.

  • Confident in engaging directly with IT, security, and data-protection stakeholders, building technical credibility and trust.

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with a high degree of integrity — able to translate findings into clear handovers and give honest answers, even when they surface limitations.

  • Fluent in German and English (spoken and written); based in or willing to relocate to Berlin for on-site work.

What We Offer

  • A role in a growing tech company where you can take on real responsibility, shape your own work, and learn a lot along the way.

  • Support to join relevant courses and webinars to build your technical and pre-sales skills with access to a dedicated Sales Coach.

  • Investing in your future – We contribute 20% toward your company pension scheme (betriebliche Altersvorsorge), because we're planning for the long run — with you.

  • 30 days of holiday – because rest matters.

  • A 37-hour working week – more balance, more time for yourself.

  • An open and honest feedback culture – growing together, learning from each other, communicating transparently.

  • A beautiful, modern office in the heart of Neukölln – central, vibrant, and well connected.

  • Fancy a change of scenery? Visit us in Copenhagen, Oslo, or Groningen – we cover your travel and accommodation so you can spend time with the team.

  • Unforgettable team experiences – from company events to trips to Croatia and Prague.

About ChurchDesk

At ChurchDesk, we believe that the church plays an important role in society. Our platform is used by thousands of congregations to organise their work, improve communication with members, reach more people, and unlock new ways of fundraising.
Our customers are part of one of the largest and oldest institutions in the world: the Church. It is undergoing significant change to prepare for the future — and we are here to support that transformation. For churches across Europe, it is crucial to work more efficiently and stay connected to their members and communities.

ChurchDesk has been around for more than 15 years — evolving from a startup into an international company serving customers across Europe. And we’re just getting started!

#jointheride: The journey matters just as much as the destination. Be part of it, celebrate successes — and have fun! We value being together, especially in the office.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Experience

jobs.title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand, while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

What you’ll do

Lead and coach the team

  • Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

  • Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

  • Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

  • Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

Own customer outcomes and portfolio strategy

  • Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

  • Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

  • Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

  • Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

  • Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

Drive expansion and account growth

  • Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

  • Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

  • Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

Build the operating system

  • Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

  • Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

  • Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

  • Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

  • Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

Orchestrate complex customer issues

  • Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

  • Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

  • Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

  • priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

  • onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

  • leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

  • GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

  • recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

  • the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred experience

  • Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

The profile we are looking for

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Consultant - Healthcare Data (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Statista Healthcare
Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista, focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties. We work with leading healthcare stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized consulting projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital ratings are published in collaboration with our trusted media partner Newsweek, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets.

We help healthcare organizations define relevant key performance indicators, validate and harmonize data structures, and translate insights into actionable strategies. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

In our consulting projects, we support healthcare providers and systems in developing tailored KPI frameworks, standardizing and validating data processes, and deriving actionable insights that enable measurable improvements in patient care and system-level performance. We combine structured methodologies with hands-on delivery to unlock the full value of healthcare quality data.

Your Role
As Data Science Consultant Statista Healthcare, you will join our international team of data professionals, supporting the analytical backbone of Statista’s healthcare activities.

Your work will focus on the collection, processing, and analysis of healthcare data that power our Rankings, Ratings, and Benchmarking projects, as well as the development of new, data-driven products.

In Benchmarking and custom quality development projects with healthcare providers and other stakeholders you will be part of an interdisciplinary project team that works directly with our clients.

You will work hands-on with large and diverse datasets, transform raw data into clean, structured information, and contribute to the automation of our analytical workflows.

In close collaboration with internal analysts, engineers, and project managers, you will ensure that our healthcare data infrastructure remains reliable, scalable, and ready for future integration into the Statista Healthcare Data Platform.

Your work will directly support Statista’s mission to make healthcare quality measurable, comparable, and actionable - globally.

Responsibilities

  • Support in maintaining and further developing Statista’s ranking and rating databases, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and scalability

  • Collaborate on data pilots and benchmarking projects — from design and metric development to scoring and results analysis, interacting directly with our clients as part of an interdisciplinary Statista project team

  • Integrate, clean, and standardize external datasets from hospitals, ministries, and partners for unified use in Statista’s healthcare products

  • Develop and document data models and scoring frameworks in alignment with the Healthcare Analysis and IT teams

  • Support the development of Statista’s Unified Health Database and future Healthcare Data Platform

  • Perform internal analyses and reporting to improve data quality and performance metrics of existing healthcare products

  • Ensure data validation and reproducibility, including peer review and internal QA checks.

  • Actively contribute ideas for new data-driven healthcare products and improvement of existing workflows

Your profile

  • Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Public Health, or related field

  • 4+ years of experience in data analytics, modeling, or applied statistics within Healthcare, Pharma or Life sciences in a client-facing role

  • Proven skills in Python and SQL, proven experience with data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar), including dashboard design and storytelling with data

  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to transform complex data into actionable insights

  • Basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts is advantageous

  • Fluent in English, German a plus

  • Highly structured, curious, and motivated to work in an international and cross-functional environment

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

jobs.title: Lead Implementation & Delivery (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced implementation, delivery or technical operations lead to own delivery after a contract is signed — and to play a central role in working out what actually makes our product work for customers.

This one is for you if:

  • You'd rather build the playbook than wait for one to exist
  • You get real satisfaction from being the person people can count on — customers and colleagues alike
  • Making a genuinely complex, technical product work in the real world, on a factory floor and not just a slide deck, sounds like a good problem to have

Every factory should be as easy to redesign as a CAD file. RIIICO scans real production floors and turns the raw point cloud into a structured, living model of the plant — machines, robots and infrastructure recognised by AI, matched to CAD, usable directly in the engineering tools our customers already run. Line changes that used to take months of manual work now take days.

We're seed-funded, backed by Earlybird, PiLabs and seed + speed, with angels including Joe Kaeser, former CEO of Siemens.

Team: two application engineers report to you directly, and you steer our data delivery team, which has its own manager and five people.
Start: as soon as you can.

Tasks

You'll own the entire post-sale delivery, from signed deal to a customer who's live, confident and getting real value. Our customers are enterprise manufacturers, so the accounts you own are complex and technically demanding from day one. As an early hire there's no existing playbook — expect to blend hands-on implementation, delivery operations and testing product-market-fit hypotheses directly with customers.

  • Own the post-sale journey, from handover through to stable, value-delivering adoption
  • Build the adoption framework for enterprise accounts, and define what "first value" means
  • Keep a current view of every account: check-ins, early risk signals, retention plans
  • Handle escalations yourself, at both operational and management level
  • Own the Sales-to-delivery handover and keep capacity visible and realistic
  • Develop the lightweight processes that make delivery repeatable as patterns emerge
  • Lead and develop your team, and shape how Delivery is structured as we grow
  • Test the product-market-fit hypotheses Sales brings back, and feed findings into Product and Go-To-Market

What this looks like in your first six months:

  • Months 1–2 — run two live enterprise implementations yourself, end to end, so you know where the product and the process actually break
  • Months 2–3 — take over the Sales-to-delivery handover and make capacity visible enough that Sales doesn't promise what delivery can't back up
  • Months 3–4 — define what "first value" means for an enterprise account, and the timeframe we hold ourselves to
  • Months 4–6 — turn what you've learned into the first delivery playbook, and bring at least two validated product-market-fit findings back to Product and Sales

Requirements

  • 4–6 years in technical implementation, delivery, project lead or technical operations roles, at a B2B company serving manufacturing or industrial customers
  • Experience as an early hire building implementation or delivery processes from scratch in a startup or scale-up
  • Experience owning the interface between Sales and a technical delivery team: handover, capacity oversight, and escalations you resolved independently
  • Enough technical depth to get fluent fast in discrete manufacturing, factory planning or industrial automation. You don't need to have done this exact thing before, but you do need to hold a credible conversation with a manufacturing engineer within a few months
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English. We work in English internally; customer work happens in German

You're eligible to work in Germany — EU/EEA citizenship, or an existing work or residence permit. We aren't able to sponsor visas for this role.

You'll fit if:

  • You're decisive and comfortable holding your ground when Sales pushes on scope or timeline — and just as good at negotiating a pragmatic trade-off without compromising commitments already made
  • You're pragmatic and action-first: you build the process as the pattern emerges, rather than designing the system before you understand the reality
  • You have commercial instinct: you notice what's working and bring it to Sales as an expansion opportunity
  • You're a fast learner with strong situational awareness, equally comfortable on a shop floor and in front of a senior stakeholder

Benefits

  • Real ESOP — actual shares, not virtual ones
  • 30 days' holiday
  • Deutschlandticket
  • Based in our Düsseldorf office, with the flexibility to work from home
  • Regular customer site visits — a genuine mix of factory floor and desk, not travel every week
  • Real ownership from day one, with a direct line to founders and leadership on decisions that matter
  • The chance to define what this function becomes as we grow
  • A diverse, international team

Apply with your CV — no cover letter needed.

How the process runs:

  1. Short intro call — 30 minutes
  2. Written questions by email — about 20 minutes of your time
  3. Deep-dive with Felix and the delivery team — 60 minutes
  4. Meet the team, then offer

The written questions are how we get to know how you think before anyone sits in a room. They're the reason we don't ask for a cover letter.

We are an employer that actively lives equal opportunity. We're committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. It doesn't matter where you're from, what religion you belong to, your gender, who you love, how old you are, or whether you live with a disability — you're welcome here.

Questions about the role? Write to Amanda Graham

Alan exists to end the wait.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing, Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations and shifts.

We think writing will increasingly be handled by AI. Knowing what to write about will not, and neither will writing something that is actually worth reading. The value moves to the person who can build two kinds of knowledge fast.

First, the topic. What a HACCP verification actually involves in a restaurant chain, why a bakery fails a hygiene audit, what a fleet manager is dealing with when hundreds of vehicles need daily checks across a country. The problems, the standards, the vocabulary, the things that go wrong. Second, the product. What Lumiform actually does, how logic, scoring, offline capture and workflow automation work, and where the product genuinely solves that specific problem versus where it does not. You build both by reading primary sources, watching customer demos and talking to the people in sales and success who hear these problems every day. The content that wins is written where those two meet.

On top of that sits original research. This is our biggest growth bet, and it will be yours to own. Benchmark reports that give this category a reference point it currently does not have, shared with industry bodies and journalists. You come up with the angle, find the data and build something worth citing.

This is a research and expertise role that ends in writing, not a writing role that starts with a prompt. You go deep, get technical, learn faster than seems reasonable, then produce content that reads like a human wrote it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on four priorities.

1. Topic ownership and expertise

  • Own assigned topic areas and content clusters. Within weeks you are the person in the company who knows the most about your topics.
  • Build that knowledge from primary sources, customer demos and conversations with sales and success.
  • Know the product properly and be able to adapt it to specific use cases and competitor comparisons.

2. Benchmark reports and original research

  • Our biggest growth bet. You come up with the ideas, define the angle and decide what is worth measuring.
  • Research internal and external data and build reports at an academic level of rigor that hold up when a journalist or industry body checks them, then work with the marketing managers to get them in front of the right people.

3. Content production

  • Write app use pages that show exactly how Lumiform works for a specific industry use case, from HACCP and fire safety to vehicle inspections.
  • Write listicles, competitor comparison pages and best-alternative pages that position Lumiform clearly against each competitor and around topics.
  • Write customer stories based on real interviews, plus newsletters and other marketing materials.

4. Publishing and maintenance

  • Publish and manage content in WordPress, applying SEO and AEO fundamentals.
  • Improve existing content on quality, relevance, structure and performance.
  • Use actual data from demos and customer calls to turn them into FAQs and on-page answers, so the website handles objections before a prospect asks one of our reps.

Requirements

Required

  • 4+ years in content marketing, meaningful time spent in B2B SaaS
  • A smart mind with a top university degree

  • Technical curiosity. You want to understand how a product actually works and which problems it solves.
  • You are able to use AI properly. It accelerates research and drafting, and the output is never final. You revise, restructure and add what the model cannot, which is judgement, a point of view and a reason the piece exists.

Strongly preferred

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Science Writer, Nebius Academy (Contract) based in Germany.

As an AI Science Writer, you’ll translate cutting-edge AI and machine learning research into accurate, engaging, and accessible stories.
You’ll work at the intersection of scientific research, technical communication, journalism, and multimedia storytelling.
A core part of the role will be reviewing new models, architectures, papers, and research to identify what is genuinely novel and important.
You’ll turn complex technical concepts into compelling written and visual narratives through articles, explainers, diagrams, charts, and other formats.
You’ll engage directly with researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to investigate ideas and verify technical claims.
The role also offers opportunities to cover major conferences, host research-focused events, and experiment with AI-assisted editorial workflows.
This is an ongoing contract position with a fixed monthly retainer, flexibility, and potential opportunities for longer-term career growth.


Accountabilities
  • Produce accurate and engaging scientific and technical reviews covering new AI models, architectures, research papers, internal research, and emerging trends.
  • Analyze technical papers and research findings to identify meaningful innovations, understand methodologies, evaluate limitations, and communicate their significance.
  • Transform complex model architectures and technical concepts into clear visual narratives, including infographics, diagrams, charts, and other multimedia elements.
  • Develop written content across multiple formats, including analytical reports, long-form features, interviews, technical explainers, newsletters, webinar scripts, and social media content.
  • Interview researchers, engineers, founders, and scientific leaders to uncover insights and provide context for stories.
  • Cover major AI research conferences, emerging fields, significant developments, and important discussions across the AI ecosystem.
  • Host or moderate research webinars, interviews, and other on-camera or multimedia formats.
  • Work directly with researchers to fact-check and verify technical claims while maintaining a clear, engaging editorial voice.
  • Collaborate with designers and multimedia producers on more complex visual and interactive stories.
  • Create visual assets independently where appropriate, using AI tools and other relevant technologies to support the production process.
  • Experiment with AI models, agents, coding, and automation to improve research, editorial, analysis, and visual-production workflows.
  • Contribute to an editorial environment focused on making advanced scientific research accessible without oversimplifying its underlying complexity.

    • Requirements:

    • Professional or academic experience in AI/ML research, machine learning engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
    • A degree in computer science, machine learning, mathematics, physics, engineering, computational science, or another relevant technical field.

    • Strong technical writing and editorial skills, with the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts accurately, clearly, and engagingly.
    • Strong visual communication instincts and the ability to explain technical mechanisms through diagrams, infographics, charts, and other multimedia formats.
    • Ability to assess the significance and limitations of research rather than simply summarize findings.
    • Excellent interviewing and communication skills, with confidence engaging researchers, engineers, and technical experts.

  • Translate the overall partner strategy into a concrete, executable marketing plan with clear milestones and KPIs

Partner Marketing Infrastructure & Tracking

  • Develop and maintain a clear view of partner marketing performance across the ecosystem

Partner Marketing Guidelines, Content & Assets

jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

 

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

jobs.title: Product Growth Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for an ambitious PM ready to build Nelly's Growth function from scratch - owning the full journey from sign-up to habit across our software, AI, and fintech surfaces, with direct impact on NRR. If you want real ownership and zero hand-holding, this is it.

 

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Translate Nelly's company vision into specific, prioritized bets across acquisition, activation, and monetisation, informed by data, experimentation, and customer behavior

  • Own the end-to-end user journey: from partial sign-up through setup, first value, and habit formation - across Nelly's software, AI, and fintech products, and continuously sharpen each stage

  • Build platform-level growth capabilities that compound across surfaces , not features that live in one place

  • Design and run a rigorous experimentation and measurement program. Form hypotheses, define metrics, ship A/B tests at high velocity, learn fast, and ship what moves the numbers

  • Collaborate deeply with Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Product Leadership on both strategy and execution

  • Inform pricing, packaging, and self-serve strategy in partnership with GTM and finance leadership - including how we package across software, AI, and fintech to drive expansion (vertical & geo)

What you'll bring:

Note: If you don't meet all the criteria, we still encourage you to apply and make the case for why you'd be a great fit. If you're exceptional talent, we're happy to adapt.

  • Shipped exceptional B2B/prosumer growth products in high-velocity environments - you care deeply about user outcomes and winning with the product

  • 3+ years in product management with hands-on PLG (and ideally PLS) experience: you've built and owned elaborated growth motions on complex B2B workflow products

  • High agency and high learning velocity: you run a high volume of hypothesis-driven bets, move fast in ambiguity, say "no" when needed, and are comfortable building from zero

  • Strong analytical skills and data mindset around A/B testing, optimization, and defining growth metrics

  • Strong data mindset: you create data acquisition and evaluation strategies, track product and agent metrics (utilization rates, precision & recall), understand online vs. offline eval trade-offs, and use insights to drive better customer outcomes

  • Passion for AI technology and its potential to reshape product-led growth

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

Even better if you have:

  • German or Italian proficiency - you can discuss real work with dentists, ZFAs/ZMVs, and billing partners

  • Experience growing products for SMB customers in less-digital European verticals (healthcare, construction, legal, architecture, or similar) where adoption is hard-won and not a given

  • Experience with self-serve, freemium, or PQL-driven growth motions

  • Experience with high-growth SaaS products using usage or outcome-based pricing, where you owned strategies to drive net revenue retention (NRR) growth

What we offer:

  • Deutschlandticket (public transport pass covering all of Germany) or a Swapfiets membership to cruise through the city

  • Urban Sports membership to sweat, stretch, or sauna your way through the week

  • Top of the line working equipment

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid setup in the heart of Berlin

  • Enjoy up to 4 weeks of workation wherever inspiration hits

  • A cozy, dog-friendly office where good vibes are basically mandatory

  • A fridge full of cold drinks and snacks waiting to be claimed

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.
