jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Nabla

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.

Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.

We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.

Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!

Design at Nabla

The Nabla design team works alongside product and engineering to define and deliver high-impact tools that delight clinicians and solve their most pressing pain points.

Our team is responsible for discovering, understanding, and framing user needs, crafting seamless end-to-end experiences, iterating on feedback, and maintaining a scalable internal design system.

 

Our product

Nabla is a medical AI assistant for medical staff, automating their administrative tasks so that they can focus on their patients, not paperwork.

 

What you'll do

  • Thrive in a rapid-iteration environment, shipping high-quality work quickly, and keeping feedback loops tight between design and engineering

  • Lead the end-to-end design process, from ideation to execution, ensuring alignment with business goals

  • Meet users during on-sites to gather feedback and test ideas

  • Partner with product managers to discover and validate opportunities with customers, define requirements, and translate research insights into impactful, well-crafted designs

  • Work with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver cohesive, user-centric products

  • Advocate for user needs throughout the product lifecycle and contribute to strategic decision-making at both the product and executive levels

  • Structure, maintain, and evolve Nabla's internal design system, ensuring consistency and scalability in design practices

 

Your DNA

  • 5+ years of experience designing product experiences at a tech or product-driven company

  • A strong portfolio showcasing user-centric solutions that make complex business logic easy to use for the end user

  • Experience designing for both web and mobile, with a strong understanding of responsive behavior and platform constraints

  • Fluency in Figma

  • Curiosity for new design/protoyping tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Paper, etc.)

  • A doer mindset: you’re ready to jump in, iterate fast, and ship

  • Proven ability to communicate design decisions clearly, from concept to implementation, across multidisciplinary teams

  • Solid visual design skills, with a strong sense of craft: you sweat the details and take pride in shipping polished, refined interfaces

 

Where you’ll be based

This position is full-time and based in Paris. or remote france if you’re the profile

Remote policy: 1-2 days a week (with some flexibility). Possibility of working remotely 1-2 weeks once a year.

Life at Nabla

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.

We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.

We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!

If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Consultant Professional Services
jobs.description:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.

About the job

The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action.

You will work across two types of engagements:

 

  1. One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..)

  2. Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services.

You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants..

This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user.




What you’ll do

  • Own the delivery of strategic consulting and analytics engagements from discovery through completion.

  • Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer.

  • Define project objectives, scope, milestones, working methods, deliverables, and success criteria.

  • Build and manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.

  • Lead managed-services engagements as the delivery owner and project manager.

  • Maintain a proactive service roadmap and identify the right missions, workshops, analyses, training sessions, and enablement activities for each customer.

  • Coordinate the work of Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants, and other specialists when required.

  • Escalate delivery risks, scope issues, capacity constraints, or customer blockers in a timely manner.

  • Ensure that customers receive measurable value from their Professional Services engagement.

  • Apply digital analytics and Contentsquare expertise

  • Analyze digital experience data and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations.

  • Prepare and deliver analyses, executive readouts, workshops, training sessions, and working sessions with customer teams.

  • Help customers define use cases, measurement approaches, prioritization frameworks, and roadmaps.
  • Assess data collection, tagging plans, data quality, measurement frameworks, and the conditions required for reliable analysis.
  • Use Contentsquare and other digital analytics tools to investigate customer questions and support evidence-based decisions.
  • Understand how digital analytics data can connect with broader customer data ecosystems, including business intelligence tools, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and activation platforms.
  • You are not expected to be a specialist Data Analyst or Data Architect, but you should be comfortable working with data and explaining analytical findings to both business and technical stakeholders.
    •  

    Partner with customers and internal teams

  • Facilitate discussions with operational teams, analytics teams, technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and economic buyers.

  • Work closely with the Customer Success Manager. The CSM owns the broader partnership, while you own the quality, coordination, and delivery of the services provided.

  • Collaborate across the broader Professional Services organization and contribute your expertise to team discussions, methods, and delivery standards.

  • Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities.

  • Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise.

    •  

    Identify risks and opportunities

  • Monitor customer adoption, engagement, delivery progress, and stakeholder participation.

  • Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform.

  • Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics.

    • Improve how we work

  • Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view.

  • Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes.

  • Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement.

  • Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team.

    •  

    What you’ll need to succeed

  • Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment.

  • Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments.

  • Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery.

  • Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions.

  • Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly.

  • Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products.

  • Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable.

  • Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes.

  • Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly.

  • Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation.

  • Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements.

  • Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams.

  • Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems.

  • Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality.

  • Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French.

  • Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events.

    • Why you should join Contentsquare
    We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
     
    Here are a few we want to highlight:
    - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
    - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
    - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
    - Lifestyle allowance
    - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
    - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
    - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts
    - And more benefits tailored to each country
     
    Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
     
    Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here. 
     
    Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws.
     
    Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Join the Pinnacle of Satellite Technology Advancement in Germany! 

Reflex Aerospace is at the forefront of propelling high-performance satellite technology to new heights within the German aerospace landscape.

jobs.description:
GESIS – Leibniz-Institute for the Social Sciences is an internationally active research institute, funded by federal and state governments and member of the Leibniz Association.
 
Starting on January 1, 2027, our Department Survey Data Curation, Team Survey Data Augmentation, located in Cologne, is looking for a
 
Doctoral Researcher in spatial data management
(Salary group 13 TV-L, working time 75 %, limited to 3 years)
 

The department “Survey Data Curation“ processes and prepares social science research data across a diverse range of data types to support sociological and political science research, especially in comparative perspectives across space and time. The curated data include long-running national (e.g., ALLBUS, GLES) and international (e.g., ISSP, CSES) survey programs, which are documented and curated to the highest quality standards, but also research data products derived from or connected to these surveys, such as geo referencing services or trend files. “Electoral Spaces” is a project of our team Survey Data Augmentation that develops a research data infrastructure for making geocoded electoral data more findable, accessible, interoperable, and re-usable.


Your tasks will be:

  • Setting up the data storage technology and programming the R interface and auxiliary tools for “Electoral Spaces”
  • Testing and assessing the tech stack to ensure it meets researchers' needs for spatial electoral data
  • Supporting data modeling, data ingestion pipelines, and curation workflows
  • Contributing to technical documentation, project outreach, and dissemination
  • Conducting methodological or applied research showcasing the added value of the infrastructure


Your profile:

  • Master’s degree in geography, geoinformatics, spatial data science, or a related discipline
  • Technical literacy in geospatial software stacks and strong programming skills in R
  • Strong interest in the application of GIS and spatial data to political and social science research
  • Motivation to complete a PhD thesis closely aligned with the project
  • Excellent English language skills


Our Benefits:

  • Opportunity to contribute to a research data infrastructure with substantial impact on the future of democracy research
  • Work in an integrated yet flexible team of quantitative social scientists with substantial synergies between survey augmentation projects specializing in geospatial data applications and democracy
  • Flexible working hours and regulations for mobile working
  • Very good conditions for reconciling work and family life, e.g. subsidies for childcare for children who have not yet attained the age of compulsory schooling
  • Holistic company health management and discounted participation in the university's sports programme 
  • Generous support for your pension provision as a direct insurance policy
  • Promotion of your skills through further training measures

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

This may not be the right role for you if: 

  • You aren't willing to put in the work: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You aren't a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
  • You have nothing more to learn: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won't get us there.

In this role, you will: 

  • This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition," and "Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role.Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition
  • Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement
  • Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles
  • Value-based selling approach
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment
  • MEDDIC experience
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways
  • Highly collaborative with a growth mindset

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.title: Director, Accounting
Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Own marketing at an AI legal research company that already has 1,900+ firms as customers.

Nylon is an AI-native tax and legal research platform used by 1,900+ accountancy and law firms across the UK, Australia and New Zealand. We were the first product accredited by ICAEW in the Legal Information and Research Software category, and we hold an ACCA affiliation. The UK business has been built almost entirely on outbound sales. It works, and it has taken us a long way. Now we want a second engine, and you would be the person who builds it.

This is our first dedicated marketing hire in the UK. There is no team beneath you yet and no playbook to inherit. There is a working sales motion, a product accountants and lawyers actually use, strong accreditation credentials, and a founder-led company that moves quickly. You will set the marketing strategy and then do most of the work yourself.

What you'll own

  • Pipeline. SEO and content, paid search and LinkedIn, email nurture, webinars and free-trial campaigns. Your number is qualified pipeline handed to our SDR and AE team, and you will be measured on it.

  • Brand and content. Sharpen how Nylon shows up in the UK accountancy and legal market: website, thought leadership, case studies, PR and awards, and the marketing side of our ICAEW and ACCA relationships.

  • Product marketing. Own the messaging. Turn what the product does into language that lands with a tax partner or a managing partner, keep our positioning against incumbent research providers sharp, and equip the sales team with battlecards, decks and one-pagers.

  • Events and community. Get us in front of the right people: ICAEW and ACCA events, industry conferences, our own roundtables and customer community. Some travel within the UK.

  • Measurement. Set up attribution and reporting in our CRM (Attio) so we know what is working, and kill what is not.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in B2B marketing, with at least a few of those in SaaS or a subscription product, ideally selling to professional services (accountancy, legal, financial services).

  • You have built something from little or nothing before: a demand-gen function, a content programme, a launch. You are comfortable being the strategist and the person executing at 4pm on a Thursday.

  • Fluent in the tools: SEO and analytics, paid search and paid social, marketing automation and CRM, and the AI tools that make a small team punch above its weight.

  • You write well. Clearly, quickly, without fluff. Most of what marketing produces is words, and ours need to be credible to accountants and lawyers.

  • Commercially minded. You care about pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics, and you enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with a sales team.

  • Curious about AI and about how professional services firms are changing. You do not need a legal or tax background, but you need to be able to learn the market fast.

Nice to have: experience marketing to accountants or lawyers; familiarity with ICAEW, ACCA or Law Society ecosystems; hands-on experience with webinar programmes or partnership marketing.

What we offer

  • £55,000–£70,000 base, depending on experience

  • Real ownership: you set the strategy, you get the budget, you build the team as we grow

  • A product customers rely on daily and a market that is being reshaped by AI right now

  • A small, fast, international team across the UK, Australia and New Zealand

Please send a CV and, instead of a cover letter, one page on how you would generate qualified pipeline for Nylon in your first 90 days.

Nylon is the trading name of Law Cyborg Limited. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. You must have the right to work in the UK.

jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken is the operating system of the future for Utilities. When a utility signs up to use Kraken, they have some big ambitions. They want to; improve customer experience, reduce cost to serve or accelerate growth and innovation. To make this possible at pace, clients need the incredible tech stack that Kraken offers, the ability to improve how they operate and to have a culture that enables them to thrive. 

Clients are increasingly interested in understanding how they can improve not only their customer operations but the business functions, and business units that sit horizontally and vertically to customer operations in retail. 

To enable this Kraken now structures itself across 3 key delivery practice groups. Human Design, Org Design and Tech. 

This role sits within the Human Design Team. 

Purpose of the Human Design Lead

The main purpose of the Human Design Lead is to be the single point of accountability for the successful enablement and implementation of culture / ways of working transformation in our clients. Human Design activities align to Global Practices and include:

  • Human enablement

  • Behavioural transformation

  • Leadership Development Programs

  • Coaching

  • Learning

  • New and existing senior clients’ relationships

    • C-suite leadership coaching and enablement 

  • Kick-start Human Design discussion with clients

      1. Line of Sight

    • Lead top-down cultural transformation, working with the C-suite and exec layer in organisations

  • Cultural stewardship

    • Embody the Kraken ways of working and support the delivery team to do the same (and ensure a consistent experience across the portfolio)

    • Act as the bridge between new clients and best practice success stories

🧠 What you bring to the party:

  • In depth knowledge and expertise in all facets of Human Design necessary to enable transformation (including cultural transformation, leadership development, coaching, learning) 

  • Experience in leading portfolios of major program transformations across different geographies

  • Track record of trust-based partnerships with C-suite and executives

  • Excellent communication skills at storytelling level across different seniorities and cultures

  • Excellent facilitation skills

  • Experience in navigating ambiguity and complexity 

  • Clear understanding of the connection between human, organisation and technology in the context of tech-enabled transformations 

  • Experience of working within the Energy, Utilities and Telco industries is highly desirable 

  • In depth knowledge of leadership and organisation behavioral best practices including concepts such as 

    • Psychological safety

    • Empowerment 

    • Growth mindset 

    • Agile leadership 

    • High performing team

What we’re looking for

  • A systems thinker who is human-led based in Paris, France 

  • We are a kind, friendly, human organisation.

  • Deep understanding of adult learning, behaviour change and organisational psychology.

  • A world-class and experienced leadership development expert.

  • A storyteller who deeply understands the art of facilitation 

  • Proven credibility working with senior leaders and executives.

  • Experience building or scaling leadership or learning practices in complex environments.

  • Calm, confident and playful presence - able to challenge with empathy and clarity.

As we are an English-speaking company, please provide your CV in English.

jobs.description:
Your mission

deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.


We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be.


You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.



In this role you will

  1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.



What you need to be successful

Must-haves

  • A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.)
  • Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge.
  • Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip.
  • Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure, ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs.
  • A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way.
  • Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further.
  • Based in or willing to work from one of our hubs - Zurich, Berlin, Munich, or London (remote within Europe is possible for an outstanding candidate, but hub-based is our strong preference given the closeness to founders and board). Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have
  • Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture.
  • Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll.
  • Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience.


What’s in it for you?


  • A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything.
  • Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in.
  • A real seat at the table - board meetings from day one, direct partnership with the founders, and full ownership of your domain.
  • An AI-first culture - the freedom (and expectation) to build the most modern finance function in European SaaS.
  • A high-talent, low-ego executive team that moves fast and debates openly.

jobs.title: POST-DOCTORANT.E / INGENIEUR.E : Conception de systèmes et d’interfaces capteurs et énergie pour les systèmes électroniques étirables autonomes – CDD 12 mois
jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que Concepteur(trice) de Systèmes Etirables Autonomes, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté au département électronique flexible. Au sein de ce département vous conjuguez passion scientifique et goût pour l’innovation.

Au sein du Centre Microélectronique de Provence, le département FEL mène ses recherches dans le domaine de l'électronique flexible et étirable, pour des applications dédiées aux objets "wearable" et au « monitoring » environnemental. La conception de systèmes complets, du capteur au module de de communication, en fonction des contraintes énergétiques et environnementales est un élément essentiel permettant la réalisation de prototypes compatibles avec les cas d'usages étudiés.

Vous aurez pour mission principale, à partir du savoir-faire du département de développer l'expertise électronique dans le domaine des objets autonomes / autoalimentés pour le monitoring environnemental (Projet Hydrademo) et des interfaces "wearable" pour la perception augmentée( Projet flexeo3D). Par ailleurs, vous contribuerez au développement de modules de formation en mastère spécialisé, dans le cadre du programme EDU4chip

  ·           Vous accompagnez le développement de systèmes autonomes dans le cadre de différents projets du département

·           Vous contribuez au montage à la dispense d'un module d ’enseignement en conception de systèmes autonomes (25h) à destination des étudiants du mastère spécialisé « Concepteur de Circuits Microélectroniques »  

·           Vous assurez la conception et la réalisation des interfaces spécifiques capteurs et énergie pour nos démonstrateurs systèmes

·           Vous participez à la réalisation de prototypes innovants et à leur test en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de recherche

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir.

 


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un :

·      Titulaire d’un Diplôme de doctorat ou d’ingénieur ou équivalent en électronique

·      Junior accepté : oui si expérience pertinente lors des stages

 

En outre, vous possédez :

•      Une expérience dans le développement de systèmes à microcontrôleurs

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

jobs.title: Onboard Software Engineer - Hyperdrive
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our core products. This is responsible for monitoring and control of major space program elements, including:

  • Flight Products computational environments (including physical and virtual processors);

  • Interfaces with external equipment (imagers, RF, ISL); and

  • Interfaces with the spacecraft bus.

Hyperdrive is the common platform powering every onboard service across our spacecraft.
The team builds the core capabilities other onboard services need to run mission logic—from interactions and housekeeping to events, automated fault detection and recovery, and lifecycle management.
By making complex spacecraft software consistent, observable, and resilient, Hyperdrive helps teams move faster while keeping missions safe in orbit.

 

About this role:
  • Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
  • Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
  • Design and implement unit tests for both self-authored and peer-authored code.
  • Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
  • Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
  • Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
  • Coordinate with downstream teams on the release, distribution and adoption of latest releases.
  • In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on-orbit fleet of satellites.

Must Haves:
  • 5+ years' software engineering experience, using programming languages including C/C++ (C++11 or newer) and Python.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with continuous integration tools (e.g., GitLab-CI, Jenkins).
  • Experience with build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
  • Experience with library management and ABI/API version control.
  • Understanding of distributed architecture.
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
  • Experience in developing multi-threaded applications.

Nice to Haves:
  • Familiarity with additional programming languages, such as Go or Rust.
  • Experience with embedded Linux operation, including Yocto, device trees, systemd, and Linux on ARM platforms.
  • Proficiency with unit test frameworks (e.g., pytest, Googletest, Unity)
  • Experience with middleware framework (gRPC, ZMQ/NATS, etc.)
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, K3S, systemd-nspawn)

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

jobs.description:
📍 Localisation : Nantes (Île de Nantes)
🕒 Date de prise de poste : janvier 2027
🌍 Langues : français courant (> C1) et anglais professionnel (> B2)
🏡 2 jours de télétravail par semaine

🤓 Lengow, une plateforme e-commerce intelligente et automatisée

Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes qui permettent aux marques et aux retailers de générer une croissance rentable.

Grâce à une suite complète de solutions SaaS combinant gestion de flux produits, gestion des marketplaces, veille tarifaire concurrentielle et monitoring des réseaux de distribution, Lengow permet aux marques et aux retailers d’accroître la visibilité de leurs produits, d’affiner leur stratégie tarifaire, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de mieux piloter leur réseau de distribution.

Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne plus de 3 600 marques et revendeurs dans plus de 70 pays.

Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi évoluer dans un environnement international et multiculturel, au contact d’équipes aux profils variés, réparties notamment entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

À propos de l’équipe IT interne

L’équipe IT interne de Lengow veille au bon fonctionnement et à la sécurité de l’environnement de travail de nos 150 collaborateurs répartis entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

Elle est composée d’un(e) IT Manager, responsable de l’ensemble du périmètre IT interne, accompagné(e) d’un(e) alternant(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux.

Notre environnement couvre notamment le support utilisateurs, la gestion du parc informatique, les systèmes et réseaux, la gestion des comptes et des accès, la sécurité et l’administration de nos outils internes.

L’équipe intervient dans un environnement multi-sites et multi-OS (Windows, macOS et Linux) et travaille à la fois sur les opérations IT du quotidien et sur des projets d’amélioration et de modernisation de notre environnement.

Objectif du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe IT et travailler au quotidien aux côtés de l’IT Manager.

Cette alternance te permettra de développer une expérience concrète et polyvalente de l’IT interne, aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Tu monteras progressivement en compétences sur un périmètre IT varié, avec de plus en plus d’autonomie et de responsabilités, aussi bien sur les opérations du quotidien que sur des projets d’amélioration. 

Tu évolueras dans un environnement international, avec des collaborateurs présents sur plusieurs sites, à accompagner aussi bien sur place qu’à distance.

⌨️ Tes principales missions

Support utilisateurs

  • Assurer le support IT des collaborateurs sur site et à distance
  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents liés aux postes, outils et accès
  • Préparer et accompagner les arrivées et départs des collaborateurs
  • Escalader les problématiques complexes à l’IT Manager lorsque nécessaire

Parc informatique

  • Préparer, configurer et maintenir les équipements utilisateurs
  • Participer au suivi du parc et à la gestion de l’inventaire IT
  • Intervenir sur des environnements Windows, macOS et Linux
  • Participer au renouvellement et au déploiement des équipements

Systèmes, accès & réseaux

  • Participer à l’administration de Google Workspace et Active Directory
  • Contribuer à la gestion des comptes, groupes et droits utilisateurs
  • Participer au maintien et au dépannage du réseau : Wi-Fi, VLAN, switches et connectivité
  • Contribuer au maintien en condition opérationnelle de l’environnement IT

Sécurité & amélioration continue

  • Contribuer au déploiement des mises à jour et outils de sécurité
  • Participer au suivi de la sécurité des postes de travail
  • Contribuer à la documentation des procédures et de l’environnement IT
  • Participer à l’amélioration et à l’automatisation des processus IT
  • Accompagner l’IT Manager sur différents projets d’évolution de l’environnement

Requirements

🏹 Profil recherché

Connaissances :

  • Bases solides en réseau (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLAN)
  • Connaissances initiales en administration de systèmes Windows et/ou Linux ; une première exposition à Active Directory est appréciée
  • Sensibilisation aux bonnes pratiques de sécurité informatique
  • Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais professionnel (B2 minimum)

Qualités personnelles :

  • Curiosité, rigueur et envie d’apprendre
  • Bon relationnel et sens du service
  • Bonnes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes
  • Esprit d’équipe et capacité à collaborer

Une première expérience en support ou administration systèmes et réseaux est appréciée, mais nous recherchons avant tout une personne avec de bonnes bases techniques et l’envie de progresser sur un périmètre IT varié.

🪜 Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien RH en visio
  • Entretien manager
  • Test technique suivi d’un débrief

Benefits

✨ Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi bénéficier de nombreux avantages :

🏖️ 5 semaines de congés payés
🏡 Horaires flexibles, 2 jours de télétravail par semaine et indemnité télétravail
🍴 Tickets restaurant (EdenRed) : 8 €/jour, pris en charge à 50 % par Lengow
🚲 Indemnité mobilité douce jusqu’à 200 €/an ou remboursement des transports en commun à 50 %
💻 Choix de ton environnement de travail : MacOS, Windows ou Linux
🩺 Mutuelle & prévoyance Malakoff Humanis

jobs.title: Commercial(e) Terrain
Commercial(e) Terrain
Commercial(e) Terrain
Coordinateur Supply Chain - (H/F/N)
Strategic Account Executive - France
jobs.description:
France-based | French required | English required | Additional languages are a plus | Approximately 30% travel

About Rescale

Rescale is pioneering the future of engineering and scientific discovery. As the leader in digital engineering, we help the world’s most advanced organizations develop better products faster through intelligent automation, applied AI, data management, and access to the world’s largest network of engineering and R&D applications.

Rescale brings together elastic, enterprise-grade HPC with advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, AI Physics, and the software and data workflows that connect them. Our customers use Rescale to modernize R&D, accelerate simulation, automate engineering processes, and turn engineering data into faster, better decisions across industries including automotive, manufacturing, aerospace, energy, life sciences, and semiconductors.

Joining Rescale means becoming part of a diverse, collaborative, and mission-driven team solving complex challenges that traditional HPC alone cannot address.

The Role

We are looking for a high-performing Strategic Account Executive to lead direct enterprise sales and account growth across France.

This is an entrepreneurial, field-based role focused on building and expanding strategic relationships with key and enterprise accounts. You will own a defined portfolio of named accounts, create demand, develop executive relationships, win new business, and expand Rescale’s footprint from foundational HPC into advanced modeling and simulation, agentic engineering, and AI Physics.

You will operate as the commercial owner of your territory: setting the account strategy, identifying business problems, building internal champions, creating compelling value cases, and leading complex sales cycles from first engagement through renewal and expansion. This is a direct-sales role, not a channel-led position. You will work closely with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Sales Development, Product, and Rescale leadership, while retaining ownership of the commercial strategy and outcome.

France is a priority market, with particular emphasis on automotive and manufacturing enterprises where engineering organizations are investing in digital engineering transformation. Success requires the ability to sell both into existing strategic relationships and into new enterprise accounts where Rescale can create meaningful business impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic key and enterprise accounts across France.

  • Build account and territory plans that identify the highest-value expansion paths, whitespace, executive relationships, and competitive risks.

  • Expand existing Rescale customers by introducing additional capabilities across the platform, from Rescale HPC to Advanced Modeling and Simulation, Agentic Engineering, and AI Physics.

  • Develop new enterprise relationships and win new logos where Rescale’s platform can transform engineering and R&D workflows.

  • Generate pipeline through proactive prospecting, account-based engagement, executive networking, customer insight, and disciplined market development.

  • Engage senior stakeholders across engineering, R&D, simulation, IT, digital transformation, finance, procurement, and executive leadership.

  • Lead the full enterprise sales cycle, including account planning, discovery, qualification, value engineering, business-case development, solution alignment, negotiation, procurement, and close.

  • Position Rescale as a strategic platform for HPC modernization, simulation acceleration, engineering workflow transformation, and AI-driven product development.

  • Articulate how Rescale’s offerings work together: HPC as the scalable foundation; Advanced Modeling and Simulation as the workflow layer; Agentic Engineering as the automation layer; and AI Physics as the intelligence layer that turns simulation data into predictive insight.

  • Build trusted relationships across the customer organization, from end users and technical champions to business sponsors, procurement leaders, and C-level decision-makers.

  • Orchestrate internal teams to deliver coordinated account plans, executive engagement, technical validation, pilots, and commercial proposals.

  • Maintain rigorous Salesforce hygiene, forecast accuracy, opportunity inspection, and pipeline coverage, with clear weekly visibility into commit, likely, best case, and risk.

  • Represent Rescale in customer meetings, industry events, and executive forums across France, with travel expected at approximately 30%.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent achievement and overachievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets through a healthy mix of account expansion and net-new enterprise business.

  • Durable growth within strategic accounts, including broader adoption of Rescale’s platform and expansion into new teams, workloads, geographies, and use cases.

  • A high-quality, self-generated pipeline across automotive, manufacturing, and other engineering-intensive industries.

  • New enterprise logos and meaningful strategic wins in the French market.

  • Executive-level credibility with customers navigating HPC modernization, simulation, AI, and digital engineering transformation.

  • Clear customer value cases that connect technical outcomes to business priorities such as faster product development, higher engineering productivity, improved infrastructure flexibility, and better R&D economics.

  • Consistent operating discipline, urgency, ownership, resilience, and transparency in a high-growth environment.

Who You Are

  • An entrepreneurial enterprise seller who creates opportunity rather than waiting for inbound demand.

  • Equally comfortable expanding an established strategic account and opening a new enterprise relationship.

  • A strong hunter with the persistence and commercial judgment to create access, build consensus, and win competitive deals.

  • Confident engaging technical practitioners while earning credibility with senior business leaders and executives.

  • Resilient and resourceful in long, complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Commercially disciplined and accountable for your number, account strategy, forecast, pipeline quality, and execution.

  • Consultative, curious, and able to translate complex technology into compelling business outcomes.

  • Collaborative and low-ego, with the influence to mobilize cross-functional teams without losing ownership of the result.

  • Motivated by the opportunity to help define a new category at the intersection of cloud HPC, digital engineering, automation, and AI.

Key Qualifications

About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Platform squads

Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. The Platform squads build the reusable blocks that make that possible, and we run them as a product: our customers are other engineers — the Solution squads, our Regional Solution Engineering pods, and customer AI teams building on top of us.

You'll lead one squad — the configurability framework, the compute layer, the widget surface, the agent-development substrate (MCP/LSP/harness/BYOM), the integration layer, or the end-user Copilot — owning a capability cluster the whole company builds on.

Your mission

  1. Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth.

  2. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean.

  3. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy.

  5. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it.

Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks.

jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.

This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.

You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.

As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.

The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.

Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.

Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.

Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.

Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.

Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.

What you'll need to have done

Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.

Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.

Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.

Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.

Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.

Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

  • You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

  • You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Screening (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)

  3. Skills Assessment & Panel (45 minutes)

  4. Values Interview (60 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO/CPO/VP Eng (40 minutes)

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Part of the Rocket Science Group, Atomic Theory comprises a multinational team of seasoned AAA veterans with roots extending from Blizzard, PUBG, Epic, and Unity.
