Two in five people in the UK rent their homes. At Goodlord, our mission is to be the gold standard platform for renting - simplifying complexity across agents, landlords and tenants.

We’re looking for a hands-on Head of Brand Marketing to own how Goodlord shows up in the world - from our brand and content to PR, corporate affairs, thought leadership and the conversations shaping the future of renting.

You’ll be a brilliant brand and communications operator who can set direction while staying close to the work. Someone who enjoys shaping stories, building a distinctive brand, working with the media, developing great content and making sure everything we put into the world feels unmistakably Goodlord.

Reporting directly to our Marketing Director, you’ll lead a talented team of four across content, SEO and design, manage our external PR agency, and work closely with colleagues across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales and the wider business.

You’ll help make Goodlord a distinctive and trusted voice in the rental industry, turning complex topics - from regulation and policy to AI and technology - into stories people actually want to read, hear and talk about. And you’ll make sure our brand doesn’t just look and sound great, but supports our wider commercial goals too.

If you like autonomy, pace and variety - and you’re comfortable being the person who both shapes what great looks like and helps make it happen - this could be a great fit!


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

The pace we move at means no two days are the same, but core responsibilities include:

Brand & storytelling

  • Own and evolve Goodlord’s brand strategy, positioning, identity and voice

  • Make sure our brand shows up consistently and distinctively across everything we do

  • Turn complex topics into clear, engaging stories that resonate with our customers and the wider market

  • Set the bar for great storytelling, creative quality and commercial impact

PR, media & corporate affairs

  • Own our PR and media activity across property, technology and business press

  • Build strong relationships with journalists and identify opportunities for Goodlord to lead and shape relevant conversations

  • Brief and manage our external PR agency, ensuring clear priorities and strong output

  • Lead our approach to corporate affairs, including regulatory and policy-related communications

  • Bring calm, credible judgement to reactive issues and sensitive moments, protecting Goodlord’s reputation while staying true to our voice and values

Content, SEO & thought leadership

  • Set the direction for our content across blogs, opinion pieces, insight-led content, case studies, social and video

  • Lead and develop our content and SEO team, making sure we’re creating useful, engaging work that supports wider marketing and business priorities

  • Shape our thought-leadership agenda around the topics that matter most to Goodlord and our customers - from regulation and compliance to AI, technology and the future of renting

  • Partner with senior leaders on commentary, bylines and external positioning, including ghostwriting and editing where needed

  • Help build the external profiles of our leadership team through media opportunities, speaking engagements, opinion pieces and awards

Creative & design

  • Lead our in-house design team, responsible for customer-facing collateral, tools, campaigns and video

  • Make sure everything we put into the world feels on-brand, well-crafted and commercially sharp

  • Work with the team to turn ideas into brilliant creative execution

Team & commercial impact

  • Lead, support and develop a team of four across content, SEO and design

  • Work closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales to make sure brand, PR and content support wider commercial goals

  • Use data and insight to understand what’s working and where we can have greater impact

  • Build strong relationships across Goodlord, bringing together different teams, ideas and priorities to tell better stories

ABOUT YOU

You’ll be well suited to this role if you:

  • Have strong commercial experience across brand, PR/communications and content - in Agency and/or B2B tech, SaaS, fintech, proptech.

  • Have owned a brand, shaping its positioning, messaging, identity and how it shows up in market

  • Have experience directly leading and developing individual contributors across content, creative, design or communications

  • Are a strong storyteller with sound strategic judgement, able to zoom out to brand strategy and zoom in to a single headline

  • Have a track record of building media relationships and delivering coverage across both trade and mainstream press

  • Can translate complex regulation, technology or industry change into engaging, relatable stories

  • Have experience of corporate affairs and reputation or issues management, with the judgement to handle sensitive moments calmly and credibly

  • Are fluent in thought leadership and executive communications - from ghostwriting and bylines to presentations and media commentary

  • Have led and developed people across content, creative, design or communications

  • Understand SEO as a growth channel and know enough to set direction, ask the right questions and challenge specialists

  • Are commercially minded and naturally think about how brand, PR and content can support wider business goals

  • Are collaborative, comfortable working with different stakeholders and happy operating at pace

  • Enjoy having ownership while still being close to the work - you’re happy setting the direction, but equally comfortable rolling your sleeves up when needed

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE

You’ll have real ownership of how Goodlord shows up in the market

  • You’ll get to work across brand, PR, content and creative rather than being boxed into one discipline

  • You’ll lead a talented team across content, SEO and design

  • You’ll work on genuinely interesting topics at a time of huge change in the rental industry

  • You’ll have plenty of autonomy to turn good ideas into action

  • You’ll be joining a purpose-driven team reshaping one of the UK’s most important industries

  • You’ll be part of a culture that believes in Letting Without Limits - for our customers, our partners and our people

This role is about owning delivery, not building a large function. If you’re looking for a purely strategic communications role with a sizeable team underneath you, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you enjoy being close to the work and making things happen, we’d love to hear from you!

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Because we're an open book and we learn from each other, we actively champion diverse perspectives and unique life experiences. If there is anything you need to participate fully in the interview process, we'd love to hear about that too - please include it in your application.


** Please note, as we are regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority, all Goodlordians are required to pass a thorough referencing check via Experian before joining the team. We will only ask for references at the point of making an offer.

No agencies please - we have tried and trusted partners we would turn to should we require support.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Strategic Finance Manager, you will be the analytical core of our finance team, reporting directly to the CFO. You will take ownership of central analysis, reporting, and project controlling across our different business models, spotting what needs fixing, automating what can be automated, and helping us scale through a pivotal period of growth.

Your Responsibilities

  • Drive COGS and gross margin analyses across all business models (RaaS, Sale + SaaS, OEM), and maintain and evolve fleet depreciation and cost models.

  • Establish robust project controlling for our deployments, implementing full-cost calculations, contribution margin accounting, and ongoing post-calculation.

  • Ensure accurate valuation of work-in-progress (WIP) and inventory in close collaboration with Accounting, including quarterly target-vs-actual reconciliations, loss-free valuation, and provisions for onerous contracts.

  • Collaborate systematically with Technical Program Managers to track project progress, billing readiness, scope changes, and remaining cost estimates without double counting across financial years.

  • Prepare and update quarterly Board reporting materials focusing on TCV, revenue, gross margin, Opex, and cash burn and advance RobCo's financial models across multiple scenario analyses for executive decision-making.

  • Lead the transition from remaining performance obligations to revenue, forecasting across customers/segments, and restructuring quarterly reporting with clear reconciliations between HGB, IFRS, and US GAAP.

  • Partner closely with Sales/Deal Desk, Solutions & Delivery, Supply Chain, and Accounting to align deal structures, purchase requests, and material usage into consistent financial models.

  • Support annual financial statements and forecast cycles alongside the CFO, external tax advisors, and auditors, serving as a strategic sparring partner on deal economics and revenue recognition.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Completed vocational training or a degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or comparable experience.

  • Several years of experience in Strategic Finance, FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Controlling, ideally within a fast-paced scale-up or manufacturing/plant-engineering environment.

  • Deep technical expertise in full-cost accounting, project controlling, WIP valuation, provisions for loss-making contracts, and advanced Excel modeling (depreciation schedules, cash flow, WIP forecasts).

  • Strong knowledge of financial reporting standards (HGB, IFRS, US GAAP), revenue recognition in project business, and familiarity with ERP systems (experience with Odoo or Xentral is a plus).

  • Culture-aligned mindset: Strong ownership, pragmatic and self-driven working style, high integrity as a strategic sparring partner to leadership, and the ability to thrive with minimal onboarding in a dynamic, fast-changing environment.

  • Very good English skills (fluent German is required, C1+ level).

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

jobs.title: Content Marketer (f/m/x) - AI-First
jobs.description:
🌟 What we do & why we do it

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams.

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.

At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.

🚀 Join us if you’re ready to build something extraordinary. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious minds who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong.

___

The role

This is a hands-on role, requiring native-level German and working English proficiency.

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy, and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling superpowers to develop concepts and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up - let’s talk!

🎯 What you'll own

  • Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis, and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

  • Plan and produce content across formats (website, blog, video, social) that performs in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and adjust based on what you’ve measured.

  • Use AI tools as your default production layer: drafting, repurposing, ideation, research, so you can ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

  • Produce German-first content (that’s also translated in English), and work closely with the wider GTM team on broader copy requirements like campaigns and sales decks.

  • Brand tone of voice, ensuring consistency and differentiation

🙋 Who you are

  • You've produced content professionally and have a portfolio or examples.

  • You have a journalistic mindset - able to interview subject matter experts to extract insights, hooks, and stories.

  • You're fluent in German, comfortable writing and speaking it professionally. You’re also comfortable collaborating, presenting, and working at a professional proficiency in English.

  • You’ve already restructured how you work around AI - whether that's tracking AI visibility with something like Profound or Peec AI, producing multilingual content with tools like ElevenLabs or HeyGen, or researching with Perplexity instead of defaulting to Google. (If your content workflow looks basically the same as it did two years ago, this probably isn’t for you.)

  • Bonus, not a requirement: you've worked with or around frontline, industrial, or blue-collar audiences and understand operator priorities.

🤩 What's different here

You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

🚀 Why doinstruct

  • 400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which gives you real stories to tell.

  • We're moving AI-first as a company and will actively help you get deeper into AI tooling, because that's the direction we're going.

  • You're joining a GTM org that's still forming its shape, so what you build sticks.

📈 What success looks like

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

6 months Content you've produced is showing up in AI answer engines for queries that matter to us, and you can point to the pipeline it's driving. You’ve established strong partnerships with stakeholders both internally and externally.

12 months There's a repeatable content engine that treats AI answer engines as a first-class channel alongside traditional search. Content is having a measurable impact on revenue.

____

At doinstruct, you'll have the chance to use your skills and help shape our growing start-up. We value a friendly work environment, open communication, and support your personal and professional growth every step of the way.

Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply.

We embrace diversity and hire people based on their ability to perform a job. People of any race, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, or marital status are welcome at doinstruct.

_

🌱 Our Core Values

Our core values shape how we work, ensuring consistency, trust, and purpose while guiding both individual actions and collective decisions. They’re not just words—we live them every day.

  • 💌 Appreciation – We cultivate an environment of mutual respect, recognizing the unique contributions and backgrounds of every team member. Success is a team effort, and we celebrate it together.

  • 💪 Drive – We don’t settle for "good enough." We are motivated by continuous improvement, setting ambitious goals, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • 🚀 Enabler – We take a proactive, solution-oriented approach, understanding the diverse needs of both our customers and our team. We believe challenges are opportunities waiting to be solved.

  • 🌟 Ownership – We take full responsibility for our work, moving with urgency and independence. We don’t wait for solutions—we create them. Mistakes are learning opportunities, and we embrace them as part of our growth.

 

🤝 How we work

We believe in a workplace culture that fuels ambition, fosters innovation, and rewards initiative. At doinstruct, you’ll be surrounded by driven individuals who are passionate about making an impact. We set high standards - because the work we do matters.

Collaboration and shared energy drive us. We believe that working together in person creates the best ideas, sharpens our execution, and strengthens our team. That’s why we thrive in an office-first environment, where we exchange ideas freely and move fast together.

We’re not about rigid structures - we’re about high performance with flexibility. While we empower every teammate to optimize their productivity, we also believe that great things happen when we’re in the same room, building something extraordinary side by side.

🌻 Let’s talk Benefits

Your well-being is a priority, and we're here to help you thrive — both inside and outside of work. That’s why we offer a variety of benefits to our team that you can find here.

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Client Solutions (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Herausforderungen

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unseren Entwicklungsteams und verbringst einen wesentlichen Teil deiner Zeit im direkten Austausch mit Kunden.
  • Du hörst genau hin, verstehst die Kundenprobleme und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Fragestellungen, die unsere Entwickler konkret bearbeiten können.
  • Auf Basis deines tiefen technischen Hintergrunds entwickelst du Lösungsarchitekturen, die sowohl zu den Anforderungen des Kunden als auch zu unserer eigenen Systemlandschaft passen.
  • Dabei denkst du in Systemen: Du verstehst unsere Architektur, die technische Umgebung unserer Kunden, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten und kannst diese Welten sinnvoll zusammenbringen.
  • Bei APIs und Integrationen kannst du nicht nur Anforderungen formulieren, sondern auch auf technischer Ebene mit unseren Entwicklern über Lösungswege und deren Auswirkungen diskutieren.
  • Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten technischen Idee auch eine funktionierende Lösung wird.
  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Engineering sorgst du für Klarheit: Was ist das eigentliche Problem? Was brauchen wir technisch? Was ist sinnvoll umsetzbar?
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Themen, koordinierst unterschiedliche Stakeholder und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick.


Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Product Management, Softwareentwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Business und Technologie.
  • Ein gutes technisches Verständnis für Softwarearchitekturen, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und API-Design. Ein Entwicklerhintergrund ist dabei ein klarer Vorteil, aber kein Muss.
  • Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und die Fähigkeit, Kundenprobleme und fachliche Anforderungen wirklich zu verstehen und in klare, umsetzbare technische Anforderungen zu übersetzen.
  • Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering: Du kannst technische Themen auf Augenhöhe diskutieren, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich vermitteln und gemeinsam mit Entwicklern pragmatische Lösungen entwickeln.
  • Interesse an Wealth Management, Finanztechnologie und SaaS sowie die Bereitschaft, dich tief in fachliche und technische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten.
  • Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden, ausgeprägtes Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder zusammenzubringen und Lösungen strukturiert bis in die Umsetzung zu begleiten.


Unser Angebot

Wir sind ein etabliertes Produktunternehmen mit dem Spirit eines Startups. Dich erwarten Teamgeist, schnelle Entscheidungen und echte Freiheit, dein Arbeitsumfeld zu gestalten. jobs.title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
jobs.description:
The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access

Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.

The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes.

We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue.

Mission: discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale - who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand.

What You Own

• Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design-partner recruitment.

• Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design-partner conversion, and initial closing.

• Build an evidence-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test.

• Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis.

• Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts.

• Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs - without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments.

• Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team.

What This Role Is Not

• It is not a traditional marketing leadership job.

• It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role.

• It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists.

• It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate;

This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority.

Important:

  • This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-term B2B contract.

  • This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany.

Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you:

  • Highly competitive salary + Bonus

  • Fully remote work environments.

  • Self-managed time off.


Who We Want

• You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI

product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue.

• You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility.

• You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,

enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.

• You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.

• You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.

• You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.

• You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.

Strong Background Signals

• Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories.

• Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.

• Large-company titles alone are not compelling.

Anti-Profile

• Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."

• You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.

• You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.

• You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.

• You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.

• You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.

First 90 Days: Window Expected outcome

• 0-30 days: 10-15 qualified ICP conversations; ~5 credible design-partner candidates; evidence-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.

• 31-60 days: Convert the strongest partners into real or production-like deployments; measure time-to-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.

• 61-90 days: Target 5+ production or production-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.

How Success Is Measured

• Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.

• Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,

retention and expansion.

• Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion.

• Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.

Operating Model and Reporting

This role works directly with the CEO during zero-to-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth.

Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth

organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes

repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles.

Security Expectations

You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially

technical environments. Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege,

deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer-data boundaries, prompt-injection

defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high-impact commitments until explicitly delegated.

Compensation Philosophy

We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder-level operator

than assemble a large conventional GTM organization. Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and

demonstrated ability to create zero-to-one enterprise value.

The Test

A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten

customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to

execute the work with minimal human headcount.
